risk_if_not_implemented: Without Maintenance of Attribute Associations By System, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to bind cybersecurity and data protection attributes to information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes (DCH-37) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Maintenance of Attribute Associations By System (DCH-37.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Media Marking
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to mark media in accordance with data protection requirements so that personnel are alerted to distribution limitations, handling caveats and applicable security requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Media Marking (DCH-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Maintenance of Attribute Associations By System (DCH-37.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability.
